title: Zenken boosts a lean sales team with ChatGPT Enterprise
summary_lines: By rolling out ChatGPT Enterprise company-wide, Zenken has boosted sales performance, cut preparation time, and increased proposal success rates. AI-supported workflows are helping a lean team deliver more personalized, effective customer engagement.
